title: MONDAY MORNING AGGRESSIVE PRAYERS & DECLARATIONS
text: This week, obey. Not I hope this week goes well. Not Lord, please let this week be better than last week. >> [music] >> Not I am asking you to consider blessing my efforts this week. This week, obey. Obey the plan of God. Obey the agenda of heaven. Obey the decrees of the covenant child who is standing at the gate of Monday morning and refusing, absolutely refusing to let this week run itself. [music] You are not a passenger in this week. You are not a spectator watching the days unfold and hoping for the best. You are a son, a daughter, a priest, [music] a king.
